cues.hombros: Start from a hang with active shoulders, away from your ears.
cues.codos: Drive your elbows down and back until your chin clears the bar.
cues.bajada: Lower under control until your arms are fully straight.

errores.balanceo: Swinging your legs to get up.
errores.cuello: Craning your neck to reach the bar.

cues.pecho: Lead with your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
cues.bajada: Lower slowly until your elbows are straight.

errores.medio: Not straightening your arms at the bottom.

cues.agarre: Palms facing each other on the parallel handles.
cues.codos: Elbows close to your body, toward your ribs.
cues.bajada: Lower under control to a hang with active shoulders.

errores.hombros: Letting your shoulders creep up to your ears at the bottom.
errores.balanceo: Swinging your body to get up.

cues.arriba: Jump or step up from a stable box, chin over the bar.
cues.lento: Lower over 3 to 5 seconds, don't drop.
cues.abajo: At the bottom, straighten your arms, set your feet down and restart.

errores.caer: Dropping during the second half of the descent.
errores.hombros: Letting your shoulders go slack at the end.

cues.brazos: Arms straight the whole time: don't bend your elbows.
cues.hombros: Pull your shoulders down away from your ears and lift your chest slightly.
cues.pausa: Hold for a second at the top and release slowly.

errores.codos: Bending your elbows and turning it into a short pull-up.

cues.tabla: Body straight from heels to head, glutes squeezed.
cues.pecho: Pull your chest to the bar, elbows going back.
cues.mesa: At home, use a sturdy table that can't tip over.

errores.cuello: Jutting your chin out to reach the bar.

cues.rodillo: Set the knee pad so your thighs stay locked in.
cues.pecho: Pull the bar to your upper chest, leaning back slightly.
cues.codos: Pull with your elbows down, not with your hands.

errores.balanceo: Leaning back to move more weight.
errores.nuca: Pulling the bar behind your neck.
errores.subida: Letting the bar fly up on the way back.

cues.codos: Elbows tight to your body, down to your lower chest.
cues.subida: Let the bar rise under control until your arms are straight.

errores.balanceo: Rocking your torso on every rep.
errores.munecas: Bending your wrists instead of pulling with your back.

cues.codos: Elbows close to your body, toward your ribs.
cues.pecho: Chest up: the handle reaches your lower chest.
cues.subida: Let your arms rise without losing your posture.

errores.encoger: Shrugging your shoulders as you pull.

cues.brazos: Arms nearly straight: your elbows don't bend during the rep.
cues.arco: Bring the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
cues.tronco: Torso leaning forward and still, abs braced.

errores.codos: Bending your elbows and turning it into a press.
errores.tronco: Moving your torso to bring the bar down.

cues.bisagra: Hips back, soft knees and neutral back.
cues.codos: Pull the bar to your belly by driving your elbows.
cues.espalda: Your torso stays still: if it rises, lower the weight.

errores.tronco: Lifting your torso to raise the bar.
errores.recorrido: Doing half reps at the top.

cues.tronco: Torso a bit more upright than in the overhand row.
cues.codos: Elbows tight to your body, up to your lower belly.
cues.bajada: Lower under control until your arms are straight.

errores.balanceo: Rocking your torso to lift the bar.
errores.munecas: Bending your wrists as you pull.

cues.bisagra: Hips back and neutral back, soft knees.
cues.codos: Palms facing each other, elbows toward your hips.
cues.cuello: Neck in line with your back, eyes on the floor ahead.

errores.tronco: Raising your torso on every rep.
errores.encoger: Shrugging instead of pulling with your elbows.

cues.pecho: Chest up and neutral back the whole way.
cues.codos: Pull the handle to your belly with elbows tucked.
cues.vuelta: Straighten your arms on the return without rounding your back.

errores.balanceo: Rocking your torso back and forth.
errores.lumbar: Rounding your lower back as you reach forward.

cues.pecho: Chest against the pad the whole way.
cues.codos: Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
cues.vuelta: Return slowly until your arms are straight.

errores.despegar: Lifting your chest off the pad to pull more.
errores.encoger: Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.

cues.codos: Elbows high and wide, at shoulder height.
cues.cara: Pull the rope toward your face, spreading your hands apart.
cues.tronco: Torso still: the movement comes from your arms.

errores.peso: Loading so much that your torso leans back.
errores.codos: Dropping your elbows and turning it into a row.

cues.barra: Bar over mid-foot and close to your legs.
cues.espalda: Neutral back and chest up before you pull.
cues.empuja: Push the floor away with your legs and extend your hips.
cues.arriba: Finish standing tall, without leaning back.

errores.lejos: Letting the bar drift away from your legs.
errores.cadera: Raising your hips before the bar moves.

cues.pies: Wide stance, toes out and hands inside your knees.
cues.rodillas: Push your knees out in line with your toes.
cues.pecho: Chest up and bar close to your body.

errores.rodillas: Letting your knees cave in on the way up.

cues.cadera: Push your hips back, dumbbells close to your legs.
cues.arriba: Stand up by pushing the floor away and squeeze your glutes.

errores.lumbar: Rounding your back at the bottom.
errores.lejos: Letting the dumbbells drift away from your body.

cues.almohadilla: Pad below your hips so you bend at the hips.
cues.linea: Rise until you're in line with your legs, no further.
cues.control: Lower and rise slowly, without momentum.

errores.pasarse: Arching your back past a straight line.

cues.mirada: Look at the floor to keep your neck long.
cues.poco: Lift your chest, arms and legs just a few inches.
cues.pausa: Hold for two seconds at the top and lower slowly.

errores.cuello: Lifting your head to look forward.

cues.agarre: Hold the dumbbell with both hands under the top plate.
cues.rango: Lower behind your head only as far as your shoulder allows without pain.

errores.lumbar: Arching your lower back as you lower.

cues.postura: One foot forward, torso slightly leaning, free hand on your hip.
cues.codo: Drive your elbow back along your side, to your waist.
cues.giro: Your torso doesn't rotate with the pull.

errores.giro: Twisting your torso to move more weight.
errores.encoger: Hiking your shoulder toward your ear as you pull.

cues.agarre: Long bar, overhand grip wider than your shoulders.
cues.codos: Elbows flared out: the bar reaches your lower chest.
cues.escapulas: Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end and return slowly.

errores.encoger: Shrugging your shoulders at the end.

cues.vertical: Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
cues.pausa: Hold for a second at the top and lower slowly.
cues.agarre: Grip slightly wider than your thighs, arms straight.

errores.rebote: Bouncing the weight at the bottom without control.

cues.vertical: Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
cues.pausa: Hold for a second at the top and lower slowly.
cues.brazos: Arms straight: your elbows don't bend.

errores.cabeza: Pushing your head forward as you lift.

cues.pecho: Chest against the backrest the whole way.
cues.codos: Drive your elbows back and close, toward your hips.
cues.bajada: Lower until your arms are straight, without dropping your shoulders.

errores.despegar: Lifting your chest off the bench to pull more.
errores.encoger: Shrugging your shoulders toward your ears.

cues.banda: Loop the band over the bar and put one knee through it.
cues.pecho: Lead with your chest toward the bar until your chin clears it.
cues.bajada: Lower under control until your arms are straight.

errores.rebote: Bouncing off the band at the bottom to come up.
